composition_subtypes.role: Compute f-values for all intervals via XOR pyramid
Compute maximum f over all subintervals for each interval

payload.core_composition_summary: Two distinct DP passes: first builds XOR pyramid for f-values, second computes maximum over all subsegments for each interval.
payload.rationale: The solution separately computes f-values using interval DP (XOR recurrence) and then applies a second interval DP to answer range maximum queries, coordinating two DP mechanisms.
